say:1:1910234001:0.text: Look at you, my little jelly... You're covered in seaweed! Where have you been exploring?
say:1:1910234001:0.source_cn: 呵呵……小浪花，瞧瞧你身上沾着的这些水草。这是去哪玩了？

say:4:1910234003:0.text: ... Ugh, that was definitely not our proudest moment!

say:5:1910234004:1.text: Well, a little stumble here and there is all part of an adventure! As long as you're all safe and sound, that's what matters.
say:5:1910234004:1.source_cn: 别担心，出门总会碰到些小意外，孩子们没受伤就好。

say:6:1910234008:1.text: There's nothing wrong with having an adventurous spirit. Just promise me you'll be careful out there, alright?
say:6:1910234008:1.source_cn: 孩子们大了，想去更开阔的海中转转也好。但是答应阿嬷，要...

say:8:1910234010:1.text: Don't worry, I won't lecture you today, my little jelly.
say:8:1910234010:1.source_cn: 好了好了，阿嬷的小浪花，不要沮丧，今天不说这个。

say:9:1910234011:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, fluffy child, the tideharp revealed earlier that Coralia will be descending soon. That means the renewal season is just around the corner!
say:9:1910234011:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, fluffy child, the tideharp revealed earlier that Coralia will be descending soon. That means the renewal season is just around the corner!
say:9:1910234011:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, fluffy child, the tideharp revealed earlier that Coralia will be descending soon. That means the renewal season is just around the corner!

say:10:1910234012:1.text: We're supposed to send you home after dinner tonight... in principle, anyway.
say:10:1910234012:1.source_cn: 孩子们，等吃完今天的晚饭后，我们就该送你们回家了……原...

say:11:1910234013:1.text: 专门负责的鳐鱼就等在外面，它会把你们安安全全地送回卡什澜。
say:11:1910234013:1.source_cn: 专门负责的鳐鱼就等在外面，它会把你们安安全全地送回卡什澜。

say:12:1910234014:1.text: 艾菲拉与你交换了一个眼神。随后，她又看向了图澜。
say:12:1910234014:1.source_cn: 艾菲拉与你交换了一个眼神。随后，她又看向了图澜。

say:13:1910234015:0.text: Grandma, could you give us a moment alone? We won't be long.
say:13:1910234015:0.source_cn: 阿嬷，我们想先单独说几句话，很快的。

say:14:1910234016:0.text: Take your time, my darlings. We've still got a little while before dinner.
say:14:1910234016:0.source_cn: 不着急，孩子们。我们的时间还很充裕。

say:16:1910234017:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll see if I can talk Grandma into letting you stay... What's your plan, Tolan?
say:16:1910234017:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll see if I can talk Grandma into letting you stay... What's your plan, Tolan?
say:16:1910234017:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll see if I can talk Grandma into letting you stay... What's your plan, Tolan?

say:17:1910234018:1.text: I wish you could stay too, but your family is waiting for you back home... Are you sure you don't want to go back?
say:17:1910234018:1.source_cn: 我很想让你们都能留下，但你的家人还在等你……那个，你要...

say:19:1910234020:1.text: Hmph, I bet they'd rather I never came back.
say:19:1910234020:1.source_cn: 哼，他们巴不得咱走得远远的，再也不回去。

say:20:1910234021:1.text: But I have a feeling... that your family actually...
say:20:1910234021:1.source_cn: 可是我能感觉到，你的家人其实……

say:21:1910234022:1.text: Say no more. I'm staying. Might as well take this chance to explore deeper waters!
say:21:1910234022:1.source_cn: 不用说了，咱留下，也见识见识海底的模样。

say:22:1910234023:0.text: Alright, I'll talk to Grandma. Wait here for me!
say:22:1910234023:0.source_cn: 好，那我去求求阿嬷，你们在这里等等我。

say:24:1910234024:0.text: Elphira scampers over to Menoa and starts sweet-talking her.
say:24:1910234024:0.source_cn: 艾菲拉熟练地跑到摩淖亚面前，又是保证、又是撒娇。

say:25:1910234025:1.text: 而摩淖亚对她的请求似乎并不是很惊讶。你注意到，这位睿智的海裔深深地看了你一眼，似乎若有所思……
say:25:1910234025:1.source_cn: 而摩淖亚对她的请求似乎并不是很惊讶。你注意到，这位睿智...

say:29:1910234027:0.text: Hehe... Don't worry about it, my darlings.

say:30:1910234028:1.text: Little jelly has told me all about it. You two have enjoyed your time here and wish to stay, right?
say:30:1910234028:1.source_cn: 小浪花都和我说了，你们是因为喜欢这里的生活，才想留下来...
say:30:1910234028:1.male: Little jelly has told me all about it. You two have enjoyed your time here and wish to stay, right?
say:30:1910234028:1.female: Little jelly has told me all about it. You two have enjoyed your time here and wish to stay, right?

choice_prompt:31:1910234028.text: Little jelly has told me all about it. You two have enjoyed your time here and wish to stay, right?
choice_prompt:31:1910234028.source_cn: 小浪花都和我说了，你们是因为喜欢这里的生活，才想留下来的，是吗？
choice_prompt:31:1910234028.male: Little jelly has told me all about it. You two have enjoyed your time here and wish to stay, right?
choice_prompt:31:1910234028.female: Little jelly has told me all about it. You two have enjoyed your time here and wish to stay, right?

say:32:1910234030:1.text: ... Well, I don't feel like going home yet.

say:33:1910234031:0.text: And my family... they don't want me back anyway.
say:33:1910234031:0.source_cn: 反正他们……也不想咱回去。

say:34:1910234032:0.text: I see. Well then, you're more than welcome to stay.
say:34:1910234032:0.source_cn: 好，阿嬷知道了。既然这样，就安心住在这里吧。

say:35:1910234033:0.text: I'll take care of everything else.

choice:31:0:1.text: There's something I must do before I leave.
choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 我有必须留下来的理由
choice:31:0:1.male: There's something I must do before I leave.
choice:31:0:1.female: There's something I must do before I leave.

say:37:1910234029:1.text: Oh, really?! Then let me be the first to welcome you into our family!
say:37:1910234029:1.source_cn: 欸，真的吗？那我要做第一个欢迎你们的家人！

choice:31:1:2.text: Right on! I can't wait to settle down in Coralia!
choice:31:1:2.source_cn: 没错，我是来加入塔拉萨的！
choice:31:1:2.male: Right on! I can't wait to settle down in Coralia!
choice:31:1:2.female: Right on! I can't wait to settle down in Coralia!

choice:28:0:1.text: That was... easier than I expected.
choice:28:0:1.male: That was... easier than I expected.
choice:28:0:1.female: That was... easier than I expected.

choice:3:0:1.text: We tripped and fell right into a heap of seaweed!
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 我们不小心掉进海草堆里面了！
choice:3:0:1.male: We tripped and fell right into a heap of seaweed!
choice:3:0:1.female: We tripped and fell right into a heap of seaweed!

say:38:1910234005:1.text: Psst... You humans don't actually play that game, do you?!
say:38:1910234005:1.source_cn: 喂……你们人类平时不会真玩这个吧？！
say:38:1910234005:1.male: Psst... You humans don't actually play that game, do you?!
say:38:1910234005:1.female: Psst... You humans don't actually play that game, do you?!

say:39:1910234006:1.text: Hehe... sounds like you had a blast. Let me join you next time.
say:39:1910234006:1.source_cn: 呵呵……孩子们的游戏真是有趣，以后也带上阿嬷一起吧。

choice:3:1:2.text: We just had a seaweed fight!
choice:3:1:2.male: We just had a seaweed fight!
choice:3:1:2.female: We just had a seaweed fight!

say:40:1910234007:1.text: ... What?! Honesty isn't always the best policy, you know?

choice:3:2:3.text: We ventured out into the outer sea.
choice:3:2:3.source_cn: 我们去塔拉萨外面探险了
choice:3:2:3.male: We ventured out into the outer sea.
choice:3:2:3.female: We ventured out into the outer sea.
